title.narrative: Strengthening Public Financial Management Capacity in the Philippines

description.narrative: The objective of this Grant is to provide focused institution-building technical assistance to the Department of Budget and Management (DBM) and 3 pilot line departments (Dept of Education, Dept of Social Welfare and Development and Dept of Health) to strengthen their capacity to implement the financial management reforms and train key departmental personnel in core accounting, financial analysis, financial control and reporting functions. Such technical assistance will enable the financial management reforms to be well-grounded in the DBM and pilot line departments. This Grant addresses two key financial management risks in the Philippines identified in the CFAA and the PEPFMR . insufficient staff training and lack of an adequate financial management reporting system for budgetary control. In the past, accounting practices were restricted to basic book-keeping and reporting to satisfy compliance. The change in use of financial information for management purposes will require a major cultural change on the part of finance and other staff, and the success of the financial management reform strategy will depend on how well the key process and capacity-building measures are undertaken by the DBM and key line departments. The DBM proposes to initiate these actions in the three pilot agencies mentioned in the previous paragraph. Each of these agencies has initiated actions to strengthen specific facets of public financial accountability. These have been reviewed in the PEPFMR and CFAA and institutional development priorities agreed upon by the various government agencies, the World Bank, and ADB. Strengthened financial management capacity in each of these agencies will also enable more effective budget execution in general. To assist the government of the Philippines in improving its capacity to implement financial management reforms and train key departmental personnel in core accounting, financial analysis, financial controls and reporting.
